title: Node worker-15 /var/log volume usage at 94% threshold

incident_payload:
[FATAL] [KafkaServer id=3] Fatal error during KafkaServer startup. Prepare to shutdown
org.apache.kafka.common.errors.KafkaStorageException: I/O error occurred while reading index file /data/kafka/order-events-14/00000000000109283.index
Broker 3 in crash loop, Zookeeper ephemeral node /brokers/ids/3 expired.
chat_history: SRE Lead: Pipeline is completely dead. Partition leader election failing across 482 partitions. Corrupted index segment detected. Must isolate broker 3, truncate dirty index file, and perform clean partition reassignment.
proposed_fix: ssh kafka-broker-3 'rm -f /data/kafka/order-events-14/*.index && systemctl restart kafka' && kafka-reassign-partitions.sh --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --rebalance

title: etcd cluster quorum loss: 2 of 3 members unreachable, raft proposal dropped

title: Calico BGP peer session flap causing asymmetric blackhole routing across spine switches
tier: Tier 3: Complex Cascading Outages / Cloud LLM
incident_payload:
[CRITICAL] bird: BGP: Unexpected connect confirm state in session 10.0.14.1
Kernel routing table shows duplicate ECMP routes with conflicting metric 1024 vs 2048. 42% packet loss between compute nodes and storage gateway.
chat_history: NetOps: BGP route flap on TOR switch 2. Calico node agent on 32 nodes received malformed route withdrawal. Must gracefully drain BGP peer and restart bird daemon.
proposed_fix: kubectl -n calico-system patch bgppeer tor-spine-2 --type merge -p '{"spec":{"enabled":false}}' && kubectl rollout restart daemonset/calico-node -n calico-system
